[Industry · Health insurance]{.project-tag}

### Claims analytics & self-serve data apps

**Problem:** Business teams needed faster, clearer insight into high-claim episodes and health-condition patterns.

**Approach:** Interrogated high-dimensional claims data in a cloud warehouse, built reusable SQL/Python
transformations, and shipped Tableau dashboards plus interactive Streamlit apps to give stakeholders self-serve access.

[Snowflake]{.tech} [Python]{.tech} [SQL]{.tech} [Tableau]{.tech} [Streamlit]{.tech}

[Government · Healthcare quality]{.project-tag}

### Healthcare quality intelligence dashboards

**Problem:** Quality-intelligence teams across WA Health services needed reliable, timely metrics.

**Approach:** Designed data models and ETL pipelines (SQL Server, Power Query, Snowflake) feeding Power BI
dashboards, and delivered the work end to end from requirements to stakeholder sign-off.

[Power BI]{.tech} [SQL Server]{.tech} [Snowflake]{.tech} [R]{.tech} [Power Query]{.tech}

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .project-card}
[Research · Geostatistics]{.project-tag}

### Mapping residual malaria transmission in Vietnam

**Problem:** To eliminate malaria by 2030, Vietnam needs to know *where* and *when* transmission can resurge.

**Approach:** Trained network and geostatistical models on 2019–2022 case data to estimate vulnerability
(importation rate) and receptivity (reproduction number, *R*) with environmental covariates. The work was funded by
a $15k ACREME seed grant for a web-based decision-support tool.

[R]{.tech} [Bayesian geostatistics]{.tech} [Spatio-temporal models]{.tech} [Raster data]{.tech}

[Paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.lanwpc.2025.101545){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}
[Talk (ACREME 2023)](workshopsandpresentations.qmd){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-secondary}
::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .project-card}
[Research · Geospatial pipelines]{.project-tag}

### Sub-national malaria endemicity & ITN models

**Problem:** Programs need high-resolution, validated estimates to target insecticide-treated nets (ITNs).

**Approach:** Built a pipeline from raw surveillance coordinates and shapefiles to analysis-ready layers, ran
Bayesian sub-national geostatistical models of endemicity, and validated high-resolution raster outputs.

[R]{.tech} [Python]{.tech} [ArcGIS]{.tech} [QGIS]{.tech} [Bayesian models]{.tech}
::::

[Research · Linked data]{.project-tag}

### Linked administrative data for child health

**Problem:** Policy questions about children in out-of-home care depend on sensitive, complex linked records.

**Approach:** Ran quantitative analyses on linked administrative datasets, and owned study design, sample-size
calculations and analytical strategy for competitive grant applications.

[R]{.tech} [MySQL]{.tech} [Record linkage]{.tech} [Regression]{.tech}

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .project-card}
[PhD · Spatial epidemiology]{.project-tag}

### Spatial epidemiology of TB & HIV in Ethiopia

**Problem:** Where are TB and TB/HIV co-infection clustered, and what drives the clustering?

**Approach:** Fused surveillance and environmental data, using population-attributable risks, Poisson and binomial
regression, and Bayesian geostatistical models to produce high-resolution risk maps.

[R]{.tech} [WinBUGS]{.tech} [ArcGIS]{.tech} [Bayesian inference]{.tech}

[Publications](publications.qmd){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}

[Open education]{.project-tag}

### Open tutorials: R, dplyr, regression & spatial analysis

**Problem:** Many public-health analysts lack hands-on, practical training in reproducible R workflows.

**Approach:** Wrote open tutorials using real routine malaria surveillance (DHIS2-style) data, ran a spatial
analysis course in R & QGIS in Ethiopia, and taught R virtually to around 50 PhD students.

[R]{.tech} [tidyverse]{.tech} [sf]{.tech} [Quarto]{.tech} [QGIS]{.tech}
